criteria.text: Check whether Robert still needs to approve extension page access and read-only Mail access
criteria.evidence: Not needed for this repository. Picturehouse pages are read by headless Chromium in GitHub Actions since 105f800 (cinema_digest/ph_scraper.py), so no browser extension page access is used. No code in the repository reads mail (searched all tracked files and history for extension, IMAP and mail-reading code: none). Checking a sent digest is covered by the run report artefact added on branch claude/dazzling-hopper-1h5hjl (commit 79d37850359db12d480aaa4bbcf58a45e9361bf8), not by reading the mailbox.
